aboutGame.title: What is Corsair Cove?
paragraphs: Corsair Cove is a single-player pirate-city simulation and strategy game developed by Limbic Entertainment and published by Hooded Horse. The full game released for Windows PC on July 31, 2026.

You build a stronghold across steep cliffs, connect vertical production chains, satisfy pirate needs, and construct ships to explore the Seven Seas. The game includes more than 50 goods, four Principle Paths, 62 Steam achievements, and interface support for 12 languages.
